subject: Refocus: shift intro demo into technical scoping workshop — dates & prework
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@symmetrixhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Intro demo — request to refocus into technical scoping

Hi Naomi + Jonas,

Thanks again for the intro demo offer. Quick note: our VP of Engineering and two execs who were planning to attend will be traveling the week of 6/22 and won't be available for a high-level product overview. Given where we are in evaluation, we'd prefer to convert the session into a technical scoping workshop focused on:

- integration points with our internal data platform (FHIR-based ingestion)
- latency and throughput targets for inference at peak loads
- authentication & key management options for a private deployment
- a short hands-on pairing block to validate the end-to-end flow

Would Redwood be able to:
1) run a half-day remote workshop (3-4 hours) with two of our engineers + a Solutions Architect, and
2) provision a short-lived sandbox or credentials so we can exercise a sample dataset during the workshop?

Proposed dates (ET): 6/29, 7/1, or 7/6 — mornings prefered but we can be flexible. I've attached a short systems overview to help with prework.

Attachments: Symmetrix_system_overview.pdf (1.2MB)

If you think this needs to be a two-day deep dive, flag that and we can reprioritize. Looking for your suggested agenda and availability.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Director of Product
Symmetrix Health
agomez@symmetrixhealth.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo — request to refocus into technical scoping

Hi Alicia — good context, and thanks for the systems doc. We can absolutely convert the session into a technical scoping workshop and provision a lightweight sandbox for the hands-on segment. Suggested next steps below.

Proposed formats (pick one):
- Half-day workshop (3.5 hrs): 45m architecture + 90m hands-on pairing (sandbox) + 30m performance targets + 45m open Q&A/action items
- Full-day deep dive (6 hrs): same as above but with extended pairing and a small load test (requires more prep)

Date options (PT / ET conversion):
- Tue 2026-06-29 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET
- Thu 2026-07-01 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET
- Tue 2026-07-06 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET

Prework we need from your side (we'll circulate a checklist once date is locked):
- sample schema or a small sample export (de-identified)
- names + roles of the engineers who will pair
- any network constraints (firewalls, egress rules)

What Redwood will provide:
- a temporary sandbox instance (pre-provisioned container + ephemeral creds) for the pairing block
- an agenda and a short prework checklist (attaching draft agenda)
- a short troubleshooting/tracing runbook we can use during the session

Attachments: redwood_tech_workshop_agenda.pdf (0.6MB)
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HS-8921 (we've linked your trial), https://drive.google.com/open?id=drivefile123 (shared doc for prework)

If 7/1 works for you, I'll tentatively hold time and loop in our Solutions Architect (Jonas) and an infra engineer.

—Naomi
